create_ProgressiveGAN: create a ProgressiveGAN instance with custom latent vector dimension and depth scale settings
build_generator_network: build the generator network using getNetG with progressive scaling and blending layers
build_discriminator_network: build the discriminator network using getNetD with mini batch standard deviation regularization
add_scale_to_model: add a new resolution scale to both generator and discriminator networks to double output size
update_alpha_blending: update the alpha blending factor between resolution scales during progressive training
